label: Glyph, Script & Fallback Audit Organ
purpose: Inspects Unicode scripts, text direction, combining marks, hidden controls, replacement characters, private-use glyphs, and fallback requirements before visual effects are applied.
rules: Never assume one font covers every detected script.
Explicit bidi controls must be visible in diagnostics.
Replacement characters are treated as source-data errors.
Glitch jitter is reduced for RTL or mixed-direction text.
